_comment: Editorial content for HRPL. Every fact here is attributable — see sourceNote. No image is attached: the company's own product photography is not licence-cleared. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available. Chief executive is null: no page read names one.
description: Habib Rice Products Limited makes rice-based starch sugars, protein concentrates and derivatives, and describes itself as the world's most diversified producer of rice products and the only fully vertically integrated one — sourcing paddy directly from farmers, processing it into syrups and derivatives, and converting some of the output into confectionery sold to households at retail. It has been developing this range since 1980, and its products are ingredients for the food, confectionery and pharmaceutical industries. The company operates alongside subsidiary companies.
headOffice: 2nd Floor, UBL Building, I.I. Chundrigar Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
